area_note: Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), including the Sala / Thu Thiem area and Thao Dien in Thu Duc, District 7 (Phu My Hung) and Binh Thanh (Gia Dinh Park)
intro: Much of Ho Chi Minh City's group running happens in the Sala urban area in Thu Thiem. RUNCLUB.VN, Good Strides and Founders Running Club all meet there, and in May 2026 adidas opened a running store in Sala as a base for adidas Runners Saigon. Thao Dien, Gia Dinh Park and Phu My Hung in District 7 are other regular bases. Club sessions start early in the morning (around 6–7am) or in the evening (around 7pm). The scene mixes large Vietnamese community groups that organise on Facebook and Strava, brand-backed and gym-hosted clubs, expat-friendly groups, and hash kennels that run trails outside the city or through its alleys.

clubs.name: Saigon Hash House Harriers (Saigon H3)

meets.where: Caravelle Hotel, Lam Son Square, District 1; bus to trails up to about an hour out of the city

clubs.cost: VND 300,000 for bus trips; VND 150,000 for city runs
clubs.who: Vietnamese, expats and tourists of all ages and abilities; runners and walkers
clubs.description: A social hash group, running since 1990, that lays running and walking trails in the countryside around Saigon and finishes with drinks. On Dong Nai trips the bus also picks up in District 2, on the Hanoi Highway near Estella.
clubs.active_evidence: Website run calendar: run #1854 on 8 Nov 2026, with runs listed to #1859 on 13 Dec 2026

clubs.name: Sophisticated Sirs of Saigon Hash House Harriers (S3H3)

meets.when: Every other Friday, check-in 7pm for drinks, run 7:30pm
meets.where: Varies around the city (published on the website before each hash)

clubs.cost: VND 100,000 hash cash, put towards dinner
clubs.description: A men-only chapter of the Hash House Harriers that runs through Saigon's alleys and lanes every other Friday, with walk (about 5 km) and run (about 8 km) options and a beer stop. It is listed as a sister kennel of Saigon H3.
clubs.active_evidence: Website 'Next Hash' post: Hash #111, an A-to-B trail from Cheers Oakwood Residences, Friday 16 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Founders Running Club :: Ho Chi Minh City

meets.where: Every Half Coffee Roasters, Sala (Tower A, 62 Hoang The Thien, An Khanh ward)

clubs.who: Founders, investors, tech and creative people; any pace, with pacers; pets, friends and family welcome
clubs.description: The Ho Chi Minh City chapter of Founders Running Club, a running-and-networking group active in 35+ cities worldwide. The weekly easy run finishes with coffee and conversation. Announcements go out through a WhatsApp group.
clubs.active_evidence: Meetup lists past runs on 24 and 31 Oct 2026 and weekly Saturday runs from 7 to 28 Nov 2026

clubs.name: RUNCLUB.VN
clubs.who: Open to all levels; first-timers can join any session. Sunday long runs split into pace teams from easy (7:00 min/km and slower) to advanced (about 3:50 min/km)
clubs.description: A Ho Chi Minh City running community, running since 2013, with four group sessions a week: strength work, intervals, an easy social run and a Sunday long run. Sessions are set by time and intensity rather than distance, and groups regroup so that faster and slower runners finish together. Updates go out through its Facebook group and Strava club.
clubs.active_evidence: Website session pages for 2, 4, 7 and 8 Nov 2026; gallery photos dated 15 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Good Strides Run Club
clubs.description: An inclusive run crew that runs from Sala on Tuesday and Thursday evenings and holds a Sunday-morning social run in Thao Dien. Run details go out through Instagram and a WhatsApp group.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated Jun to Oct 2026, latest 17 Oct 2026

clubs.name: adidas Runners Saigon
clubs.who: Open community backed by adidas; sessions led by coaches, crew and pacers
clubs.description: adidas's Saigon running community, which also has a large Facebook group. In May 2026 adidas opened its Sala Running Store at 72 Nguyen Co Thach as a hub for the club, with a 5.3 km opening run for AR Saigon members and other runners. VnExpress (Nov 2024) reported runs combined with strength work, yoga or talks on Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays, following an adidas Runners marathon curriculum.
clubs.active_evidence: Tuoi Tre News report on the adidas Sala Running Store opening, set up as a hub for AR Saigon, with a 5.3 km run with AR Saigon members, 30 May 2026

clubs.name: Giadinh Runners
clubs.who: Open to all regardless of age or gender
clubs.description: A community of runners who train in and around Gia Dinh Park, with about 1,360 members on Strava. Members post Saturday-morning runs on the club page.
clubs.active_evidence: Member posts on the Strava club page, Jun–Aug 2026 (member-authored, not club announcements)

clubs.name: CrossFit Thao Dien Free Run Club

meets.where: CrossFit Thao Dien, 3-5 Le Van Mien, An Khanh ward (Thao Dien)

meets.when: Fridays 6:00am (easy Zone 2 5 km loop around Thao Dien)
meets.where: CrossFit Thao Dien, 3-5 Le Van Mien, An Khanh ward (Thao Dien)

clubs.who: Open to everyone, from first-time runners to experienced runners; coaches adapt the workout to each level
clubs.description: A free run club hosted by the CrossFit Thao Dien gym, with a coached interval session on Tuesdays and a conversational-pace 5 km loop of Thao Dien on Fridays.
clubs.active_evidence: Gym blog post announcing the run club, published 13 Jul 2026
